learning_outcomes.text: Can comprehend and speak German in environments like work, school etc.
Can travel the countries where German is native language.
Can write simple text or personal letter about personal interests.

syllabus_topics: Entitling furniture and electronic devices - Expressing likes/dislikes - Pronouns - Colors - Numbers starting from 100 to 1.000.000
Understanding newspaper advertisement, flat advert - Describing different desks with adjectives
"My day" - "From morning to night" (listening) - Daily routines verbs like "frühstücken, spazieren gehen, kochen, aufstehen"
Hours (official and unofficial) - Separable and unseparable verbs - Naming daily activities
Days of week, time slices - Mentioning a day with all the actions - Structure of inverted sentence
- Signboards, answer machine - Hour of work - "A day in Berlin"
Months and seasons - Opening dialogue at restaurant and shopping - Accusative case
Hobbies and talking about free time - Nodding, objecting, negating during talking
Weather forecast, talking about weather forecast - Different irregular verbs
Life-long learning - "Distance learning" (listening) - Talking about listening
Expressing abilities - Speaking about wishes and goals - Mentioning sentence structure again
Speaking about past events (Perfect structure) - Comparing simple past tense and present continuous tense - Talking about past activities

Understanding a recommendation text about language learning - Talking about learning oriented targets and studying habits - Film: Exclamations (Ui, oje, na, etc.- finding Turkish equivalent) - General Revision/Workbook Exercises
bibliography: Schritte International 1-Niveau A1/1 Kursbuch+Arbeitsbuch, Hueber Publisher
